name: DualEntry
description:
Run your books without leaving the conversation. Access and create financial records across your ledger, draft revenue recognition contracts with automated billing and recognition schedules, and capitalize fixed assets with full depreciation schedules. Review bank-match suggestions to speed up reconciliation, look up any transaction by number, trace audit trails, and fuzzy-match customers, vendors, and accounts.

Access is governed by your existing DualEntry role and permissions.

_published_faq.name: How do I add DualEntry to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add DualEntry to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.dualentry.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the DualEntry MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: DualEntry lists 15 MCP tools, including create_contract, create_fixed_asset, get_contract_detail, get_record_by_number, get_record_detail, get_record_history, get_related_records, list_bank_match_suggestions, list_companies, preview_contract_schedule, preview_fixed_asset_schedule, and save_entity.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to DualEntry?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to DualEntry in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
DualEntry requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
DualEntry is developed by DualEntry. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
